title: Algeria admitted to the United Nations
note: The General Assembly votes on Algeria's admission as the 109th member.

title: Uganda becomes independent
note: The Uganda Protectorate becomes an independent Commonwealth realm under Prime Minister Milton Obote (the British-held provinces should pass to a new Ugandan state).

title: Second Vatican Council opens
note: Pope John XXIII opens the ecumenical council in St Peter's Basilica.

title: French referendum on direct election of the President
note: De Gaulle asks voters to approve election of the President by universal suffrage, bypassing Parliament's objections.

title: Northern Rhodesian general election
note: First election under the new constitution; African nationalist parties (UNIP, ANC) could win a majority, threatening the Federation.

title: Tanganyikan presidential election
note: Julius Nyerere is the TANU candidate for the presidency of the new republic.

title: US midterm elections
note: All House seats and 39 Senate seats; Cuba is a Republican campaign theme.

title: Tanganyika becomes a republic
note: First anniversary of independence; the President takes office.

title: Southern Rhodesian general election
note: Whitehead's United Federal Party faces the new segregationist Rhodesian Front.

title: Kennedy-Macmillan conference at Nassau
note: Scheduled Anglo-American summit in the Bahamas; the future of Skybolt and Britain's deterrent are on the table.

title: Dominican general election
note: First free election after the Trujillo dictatorship; Juan Bosch (PRD) against Viriato Fiallo (UCN).

title: Indonesian flag raised in West New Guinea
note: Under the New York Agreement the Indonesian flag flies beside the UN flag from this date.

title: Brazilian plebiscite on the presidential system
note: Voters decide whether to keep the 1961 parliamentary system or restore Goulart's full presidential powers.

title: Italian general election
note: Test for Fanfani's centre-left 'opening to the left'.

title: UNTEA hands West New Guinea to Indonesia
note: End of the UN Temporary Executive Authority; administration passes to Indonesia, with an 'Act of Free Choice' promised by 1969.

title: Kenyan general election
note: Pre-independence election for internal self-government (KANU vs KADU), held 18-26 May.

title: Planned formation of Malaysia
note: Target date agreed in London (July 1962) for Malaya, Singapore, North Borneo and Sarawak (and possibly Brunei) to federate. Opposed by Indonesia and the Philippines.
